name: Pipes of Haunting

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Play
powers.text: Magic action, 1 charge: creatures of your choice within 30 ft make a DC 15 Wisdom save or are Frightened for 1 minute.

summary: 3 charges: an eerie tune frightens creatures within 30 ft (Wis DC 15) for a minute.
text: Only a creature proficient with wind instruments can use these pipes, which hold 3 charges and regain 1d3 of them each dawn. As a Magic action, spend 1 charge to play a haunting, mesmerising melody: every creature you choose within 30 feet makes a Wisdom saving throw against DC 15, and on a failure it has the Frightened condition, which lasts 1 minute. A frightened creature gets a new save whenever one of its turns ends, freeing itself on a success.
